description.value: Who was this powerfully attractive stranger? A darkly handsome man who'd inflamed her with intense desire and then kissed her with such intense passion. Keira's new boss, that was who. Jay was a maharaja's heir, a billionaire businessman in his own right, and he'd hired Keira for her talents in interior design. But he couldn't understand why she ran from blazing hot to icy cold and back again. Was she the worst kind of wanton, who would tease in a bid to increase her financial reward? Then Jay discovered - first hand - Keira was a virgin. And, according to his code, the price of taking virginity was marriage. Was it a price he was prepared to pay?

Abandoned by her lover and forced out of the university, Jessica Trelawney was at rock bottom the day Gideon Cavilha offered her a job and immediately escape from the consequences of loving foolishly.
At Pillatoro, Gideon's magnificent family estate, Jessica felt a strange sense of belonging. She was drawn to her aloof yet passionate employer as if he were a part of her destiny.
But Jessica's job threatened to tear them apart. Gideon was determined to have her verify his father's historical theories. As a historian, Jessica couldn't lie - not even for the man she loved.

table_of_contents.title: Emma Shaw had escaped an uncomfortable situation by fleeing to Credlestone Hall, her uncle's isolated home in Dartmoor. But when she arrived late one foggy night, her uncle wasn't there. Another man was. A man named Jake Garrani.

Jake, it turned out, was a friend of her uncle's and a well-known artist. He was living at the house because he needed a quiet place to work, and he didn't want Emma "hanging around," disrupting his concentration. If she stayed, she'd have to pose for him....

/> It was the last thing the shy and emotionally battered Emma wanted to do. But she refused to be scared off by this ... this tyrant. And she refused to give in to the attraction that sprang up between them. An unwanted attraction -- no matter how exciting, how compelling, it might feel!

description.value:
A amante certa... porém, a noiva errada! 

Lindy ficou surpresa ao saber que despertava o desejo de Atreus Dionides. Logo ela, com sua aparência simples e seu estilo de vida modesto produzindo velas e pot-pourri para vender! Atreus, no entanto, encantara-se com suas curvas desde a primeira vez que a vira... e mais ainda depois da ardente noite de paixão que tiveram. Mas Lindy logo descobriria que havia ido longe demais em seus sonhos: era apenas uma amante de fim de semana. Obviamente ele se casaria com uma mulher de alta linhagem da sociedade grega. However, Atreus seemed enchanted by her curves when he made passionate love to her at his country retreat. But Lindy came down to earth with two bumps, first when Atreus revealed she was just his weekend mistress; his bride would be selected from the upper echelons of Greek society. The second bump she wouldn't be able to hide ... because she was carrying Atreus's baby!
